name: Paluma Range National Park
disclaimer: Walking times are estimates only and assume a steady pace without breaks. Track conditions change; carry a paper map and tell someone your plans.

emergency.notes: Mobile reception across the Paluma plateau is unreliable and often absent in the gullies. Give your location as coordinates and the nearest junction number.
